name: Turnkey
description: Programmatic server-side key management and wallet signing for autonomous agents and server processes. Provides MPC-based key management with a policy engine for controlling signing permissions. The canonical solution for autonomous agent wallet infrastructure.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The recommended server-side signing solution in solana-trading-agent. No alternative of comparable quality for server-side Solana agent signing.
Used in Base AI agent patterns where fully autonomous signing without user interaction is required.
Production server-side signing for Ethereum autonomous agents and institutional flows.
Used in Farcaster agents where autonomous transaction signing is required.

common_pairings.context: Vercel AI SDK provides the reasoning layer that decides what transaction to execute; Turnkey signs the resulting transaction server-side.
Helius monitors onchain events; Turnkey signs the agent's responses to those events.
Jupiter computes the swap route; Turnkey signs the resulting transaction for submission.
Turnkey signs the transaction; Jito submits the signed transaction as an MEV-protected bundle.
Trigger.dev orchestrates the agent workflow steps; Turnkey handles signing within those steps.

trust_evidence.description: Turnkey is the default server-side signing solution in solana-trading-agent and recommended for all autonomous agent wallet management in WORKFLOWS.md.
Turnkey maintains separate SDKs for server (@turnkey/sdk-server), Ethereum (@turnkey/ethers, @turnkey/viem), and Solana (@turnkey/solana), indicating mature product segmentation.
Built by the former Coinbase Custody engineering team. Strong institutional pedigree for key management.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Skip Turnkey at hackathon scale. Use a simple keypair from a .env file for development. Never put private keys in production.
scale_guidance.mvp: Integrate Turnkey before connecting to live funds. Private key in .env is not acceptable for any real value flow.
scale_guidance.production: Required for any autonomous agent handling real funds. Configure policy engine with per-transaction spending limits before live trading. Turnkey is the production standard for autonomous agent signing.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When the agent has user interaction and the signing is user-initiated (not fully autonomous). Privy's server-auth SDK handles user-delegated signing but is not designed for fully autonomous agent signing.

anti_patterns: CRITICAL: Using browser wallets or @privy-io/react-auth for autonomous server-side agent signing. Browser wallets require user interaction. For autonomous agents, use Turnkey.
CRITICAL: Storing raw private keys in environment variables for production agents. Turnkey provides proper key management with policy controls.
Skipping Turnkey's policy engine configuration — an agent with no spending limits can execute expensive actions at machine speed.
Using Turnkey without defining a sub-organization per agent — isolating agent keys to sub-organizations provides blast radius containment.

sdk_migration.notes: @turnkey/sdk-browser (v6.0.0) is self-described as deprecated in its README in favor of @turnkey/core (v2.0.0, May 2026). The npm deprecated flag is not formally set. @turnkey/http remains an actively maintained lower-level primitive. React users should migrate to @turnkey/react-wallet-kit v2.0.0.
